title: Software Engineer, iOS Core Product - Munich, Germany
description:
The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its App of the Day.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

Overview

With the growth of our iOS app, being the #18 productivity app in the App Store category and also our recent recognition as Apple's 2025 Design Award for inclusivity, we find the need for a Senior iOS Engineer to help us support the new user base as well as work on new and exciting projects to push our missing forward.   

This is a key role and ideal for someone who thinks strategically, enjoys fast-paced environments, passionate about making product decisions, and has experience building great user experiences that delight users.

We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount. 

Our interview process involves several technical interviews and we aim to complete them within 1 week. 

What You'll Do

  • Opportunity to lead key engineering and product decisions
  • Actively shipping production code for the Speechify iOS app
  • Work within a dedicated product team
  • Participate in product discussions to shape the product roadmap
  • Maintain and enhance the existing complex app architecture

An Ideal Candidate Should Have

  • Experience. You've worked on products that scaled to a large user base
  • Track record. You have worked on various products from inception to decent traction. You have been responsible for engineering the product
  • Customer obsession. We expect every team member whose responsibilities directly impact customers to be constantly obsessed about providing the best possible experience
  • Product thinking. You make thoughtful decisions about the evolution of your product and support internal teams and designers into taking the right direction
  • Speed. You work quickly to generate ideas and know how to decide which things can ship now and what things need time
  • Focus. We're a high-growth startup with a busy, remote team. You know how and when to engage or be heads down
  • Technical skills. Swift, SwiftUI

Technical Requirements:

  • Swift Programming Language
  • SwiftUI experience
  • Experience in Multithreading Programming
  • Working with CI/CD infrastructure
  • Experience with Fastlane
  • SOLID principles, the ability to write every single class according to SOLID
  • Experience with Git and understanding of different Git strategies

What We offer:

  • A fast-growing environment where you can help shape the company and product
  • An entrepreneurial crew that supports risk, intuition, and hustle
  • The opportunity to make a big impact in a transformative industry
  • A competitive salary, a collegiate atmosphere, and a commitment to building a great asynchronous culture
  • Work on a product that millions of people use and where daily feedback includes users sharing that they cried when they first found the product because it was so impactful on their lives
  • Support people with learning differences like Dyslexia, ADD, Low Vision, Concussions, Autism, and Second Language Learners, and give reading superpowers to professionals all over the world
  • Work in one of the fastest growing sectors of tech: Intersection of Artificial Intelligence and Audio

description:
About Us

At VREY, we're building the EnergyOS for multi-family buildings.

Germany has over 3.3 million apartment buildings — and they are the blind spot of the energy transition. <1% solar penetration. <2% smart metering. Almost no flexibility or intelligent energy management.

What's missing is an integrated system that makes this transition economically viable and operationally manageable.

VREY combines certified meter operation with proprietary software, enabling property owners to sell self-generated solar power directly to their tenants — simply, and without having to become an energy supplier themselves (§42b EnWG). Regulatory obligation becomes a profitable, predictable opportunity:

  • Double-digit returns and asset appreciation for owners,

  • ~20% electricity cost savings for tenants, and

  • digital infrastructure for storage, heat pumps, and flexibility.

We already manage a three-digit number of projects — including some of Germany's largest property holders and housing cooperatives — in all 16 federal states. In the course of our seed financing, we raised €3.3M from leading impact and energy VCs (including Rubio Impact Ventures, HTGF, and Kopa Ventures). We're now entering the next growth phase and expanding our team.

We're at the beginning of a structural market shift. Join us and help build the leading EnergyOS.

Your Profile

  • You have 2+ years of professional experience building and running full-stack web applications, ideally with Ruby on Rails. Experience in comparable frameworks (Django, Laravel, Spring Boot, NextJS) will also be considered, if you are truly motivated to learn and work with Rails.

  • You have a strong understanding and hands-on experience designing and optimizing relational database schemas (we use PostgreSQL).

  • You are used to working with APIs and integrating with 3rd-party services.

  • You have solid experience setting up and maintaining cloud/server infrastructure. We have a basic Heroku setup and Github CI/CD and need to gradually scale and improve monitoring etc.

  • You have at least basic frontend development skills, ideally with solid fundamentals (HTML, CSS and JavaScript), as well as familiarity with both the Rails way (Hotwire, Turbo and Stimulus) and a framework like React or Vue.

  • You are actively working with AI and pushing for efficient agentic setups; we are establishing Claude Code in the team and the whole company.

  • You like to take ownership for the features and components you work on and you are proactive in the product development.

  • You are excited about startups and want to make a real impact on the product and the company in a truely agile way.

  • You are based in Berlin (or willing to relocate). You will enjoy working in our office in Friedrichshain with the team most of the time, with the flexibility of 1-2 remote work days a week.

  • You are willing to learn energy industry terms in English and German and being comfortable with some parts of the company operating mostly in German. (Team language is English.)

  • Nice to have: You have experience working with multi-tenancy systems and/or are experienced with payment provider integration (e.g., Stripe Connect)

Your Responsibilities

You will be an early member of our growing product development team, working across the entire stack.

The core functionality of the VREY platform is processing smart meter measurement data for analyzing and billing solar power usage. For this purpose, we provide landlords and tenants with a portal and automate contract management, invoicing and payment flows. An admin interface and integration with internal tools enable the creation and management of projects by our operations team.

While working on features and integrations, you also help us improve our infrastructure and backend processes, enabling our platform to scale.

1. Full-stack feature development

  • You co-design and build features across the full stack, from database to UI.

  • You work directly with product management, design and internal users to get the details right.

  • You ensure that our features perform well for a growing number of users.

2. Data processing, automation and reliability

  • You co-own the development of our crucial backend processes: importing and processing of smart meter measurement data and automated billing.

  • You help designing and maintaining the underlying server infrastructure.

  • You instrument, optimize and monitor critical processes so they remain fast, reliable and dependable as we scale.

3. Technical design, architecture and engineering excellence

  • You research, evaluate and design technical solutions to new problems together with the team.

  • You contribute to our aspiration to get better and more efficient as engineers and as a team every day.

  • You continuously improve our development environment and engineering processes, including adopting the right tools, workflows and AI-powered development practices.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary including shares based on the level of your experience.

  • Real ownership: You shape VREY actively from day one. Ownership means responsibility for your tasks end-to-end and the opportunity to take leadership.

  • Visible impact: We ship features every day that make a difference for our customers and colleagues.

  • Personal and professional growth: We have very skilled and experienced people on the team that you can learn from and we actively provide opportunities to develop your career.

  • Making a difference: Our daily work reduces energy costs for tenants, advances the energy transition in residential buildings, and accelerates the economic decarbonisation of Germany's housing stock.

  • Great workplace: Office in a cool co-working space in Berlin-Friedrichshain, with free drinks, cerials, fruits, and plenty of lunch options nearby.

We're a team that shares lunch, swaps ideas, welcomes new faces regularly, and genuinely listens — come help shape what comes next.

At VREY, we believe that diversity strengthens both our company and society. We do not make hiring or employment decisions based on race, religion, ethnicity, nationality, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, or age.

Even if you don't meet every requirement, don't hesitate to apply. If you're excited about our mission and believe you can contribute, we want to hear from you!

Sound like your kind of place? Let's build together.

You'll be the engine of our sales team — the first voice new businesses hear when they discover Mollie. That's not a small thing. Every inbound lead is a real company looking for a better way to manage payments, and you'll be the one who helps them find it. You'll move fast, think on your feet, and make sure no opportunity slips through the cracks.

This role is built for someone who wants to learn sales properly, from the ground up. You won't just be passing leads along — you'll own the full sales cycle for smaller businesses, closing deals yourself and building the skills that will define your career. Alongside that, you'll sharpen your instincts through outbound prospecting, giving you a complete picture of how great commercial teams operate.

If you're ambitious, curious, and ready to grow fast in a company that's scaling across Europe, this is where you start.

 
 

What you'll ship

  • Qualify leads effectively by understanding each business's needs, challenges and goals — and matching them to the right Mollie solution

  • Own the full sales cycle for smaller businesses, taking deals from first contact through to close

  • Route high-potential leads to the right Account Executives with clean, well-documented handovers that set the next stage up for success

  • Build pipeline through targeted outbound prospecting, complementing inbound work with proactive engagement

  • Keep CRM records accurate and up to date, and feed insights back to Sales and Marketing to help sharpen our acquisition strategy

 
 

What you'll bring

  • Fluency in German and English — you're confident communicating clearly and professionally in both, written and spoken

  • Exceptional communication skills — you know how to listen, ask the right questions, and get your point across without overcomplicating it

  • Genuine curiosity about business, e-commerce and technology — you like understanding how things work and you're drawn to solving problems

  • Ambition and a coachable mindset — you're hungry to grow, open to feedback, and motivated to keep improving

  • Resilience and a positive attitude — you don't get thrown off easily, and you bring energy to the work even when things don't go to plan

  • Some experience in a sales or customer-facing environment is a plus, but not a dealbreaker — we care more about drive and potential than a polished CV

title: (Senior) Software Engineer
description:
Few people get to build a bank from scratch. Even fewer get to build one at a moment when banking itself is being reinvented.


The Dollar is the best product in the history of the world - there is infinite global demand. But International Fintechs and non-US banks are left with two unsatisfying options to access it: Either they build on legacy clearing banks that are slow and unreliable, or they interface with middleware providers that don’t move and hold the dollars directly, but themselves rely on underlying legacy banks. Augustus collapses this stack by combining two things: A real, national bank charter (in organization), and Marble, our proprietary core banking system, built around intelligence, made of code.


We are a group of operators, unicorn early employees, ex-founders and people who walked away from degrees because they believe this is an industry and career defining opportunity. We are backed with more than $200M from Peter Thiel's Valar Ventures, Tiger Global, Hummingbird, QED, Creandum, and the founders of Nubank, Ramp, Deel, Circle, Fluidstack, Fuse, and n8n.


We are regulated in Europe and live with Euro and Stablecoin clearing today. Now, we are building the US team from the ground up, while continuing to grow rapidly in Europe.

The Role

You're a super IC in a small, elite engineering team. You work on core banking systems and own projects end to end. You take on big projects, drive them yourself, and deliver.

You work with engineering, product, and clients. You turn complex financial problems into clean code. You're trusted with the big calls from day 1; system design, technical tradeoffs, what we build and what we don't. The team is small on purpose, that means you have a lot of ownership, you move fast, and you make decisions that actually matter.

You're part of the product engineering team building the Programmable Bank - a bank for the new age of money movement, built around Digital Assets and AI. Your team builds the banking core across bare metal central bank infrastructure and blockchain infrastructure. We're building a Swiss clock: your job is precision engineering, translating a complex system into simple, clean code that runs reliably at scale.

Your First Six Months

Understand the codebase and increase your ownership rapidly.

  • Months 1-2: You ramp up fast. Understand the codebase, the domain, the product and ship meaningful code in your first weeks. Pick up a major project as an IC and start driving it. You're pairing with the team but operating independently early.

  • Months 3-4: You've shipped your first big project end to end. You know the domain well enough to push back on product decisions when something doesn't make sense. You're starting to influence technical direction - how we model data, how we handle edge cases, where we take shortcuts and where we don't.

  • Months 5-6: You're one of the people the team relies on for the hardest problems. You scope and drive projects autonomously. You have strong opinions on how the core banking systems should evolve and you're acting on them. Junior engineers come to you because your code is clean and your thinking is clear.

Who Will Thrive At Augustus

We believe that throwing smart people with high agency at big problems produces the best outcomes. The people who succeed here share the following traits:

  • Relentless: You can't leave something broken. You don't stop because it got hard or because no one is watching.

  • Set The Bar: You're harder on yourself than anyone else would be. You don't need external accountability to care about quality.

  • Shape The Game: You don't wait for a playbook and you don't need one. You walk into genuinely new territory and figure it out. You move before anyone asked you to.

  • Systems First: You don't solve problems by adding people or effort. You build systems that make the problem smaller. Your first instinct is to automate, not to handle it manually.

This role is for you if:

  • Your former teammates would put you in the top 5% of engineers they've worked with - your code is clean, correct, and easy to delete.

  • You merge your PR today, not tomorrow. You ship and iterate rather than wait for perfection.

  • You want to build core banking systems that handle real money, not another CRUD app.

  • You care about simplicity more than cleverness.

  • You'd rather own a problem end to end than wait for someone to hand you a spec.

  • You want to work alongside people who are genuinely great at what they do.

This is not for you if:

  • You think that a new fancy pattern or architecture principle will solve all your problems.

  • You think "that's not my problem" is an acceptable answer.

  • You can not follow other team member’s decisions.

  • You are closing your macbook at 5pm sharp and don’t care about your work.

  • You are not passionate about what you do.

Hard Requirements

  • 5+ years of hands-on software engineering experience (backend-focused).

  • 2+ years in early-stage or small startup environments.

  • Based in Berlin or willing to relocate.

Pay transparency

Compensation packages at Augustus include base salary, equity, and benefits. New hire offers are made based on a candidate's experience, expertise and geographic location. The annual base salary range for this role is €100,000-€150,000 + equity.

What We Offer

  • Career Growth: You will be given more responsibility and pushed to grow faster than ever before.

  • Network: Your peers are brilliant, highly motivated people. These people will be foundational in your future opportunities.

  • Real Participation: Employees are shareholders. You will think and act like an owner.

  • Perks & Benefits: Relocation support, visa support, the latest Apple gear (MacBook + AirPods), lunch benefit, gym benefit, a beautiful office in the heart of the city, 4x on-/offsites per year, and an annual development budget.

Additional to the global benefits above, we offer localized benefits such as comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance and a 401(k) retirement plan for our US team.

Augustus is committed to creating an inclusive environment where people from all backgrounds can thrive and where different viewpoints and experiences are valued and respected. Augustus will consider all applications for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, national origin, religious beliefs, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, neurodiversity, disability, age, parental or veteran status.

Compensation: €100K – €150K • Offers Equity

Was wir von der Position erwarten

Bei aleno wirst du zum “Unternehmer/ Unternehmerin im Unternehmen”. Du bist unser Marketing – von der ersten Idee bis zur Umsetzung. Konkret heißt das: 

  • Marketing bei aleno in seiner ganzen Breite: Marke stärken und weiterentwickeln (Brand) und Wachstum treiben (Growth). Beides, nicht nur eins davon. 

  • Du legst das Fundament: Zum Start bist du unser Marketing. Die einzige Person im Team. Auf dem, was du aufbaust, wächst die Abteilung weiter, auch personell. 

  • Strategie mitgestalten und selbst umsetzen: Gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsführung legst du fest, wohin es geht. Danach übernimmst du: definieren, umsetzen, messen, nachschärfen, reporten. 

  • Du entwickelst Strukturen weiter: Du setzt Marketing-Automation und den richtigen Tool-Stack auf, pflegst und optimierst sie. 

  • Du arbeitest “Data & KI first”: Deine Entscheidungen basieren auf Daten, nicht nur auf Bauchgefühl. KI ist für dich kein “nice to have”, sondern tägliches Werkzeug, das du schon gekonnt einsetzt. Für Content, Kampagnenoptimierung, Analysen, usw. 


Woran du gemessen wirst

  • Wachstum: Deine Maßnahmen sorgen für mehr und bessere Leads, die in direkter Zusammenarbeit mit Sales zu echtem Umsatz werden. (Sales Qualified Leads & Revenue) 

  • Markenbekanntheit: aleno wird im DACH-Raum als Marke sichtbarer und stark in der Hospitality-Szene wahrgenommen. 

  • Wirksames Marketing: Alles, was du tust, zahlt messbar auf unsere gemeinsamen Wachstumsziele ein, nicht auf Vanity Metriken.


Was du mitbringst

  • Erfahrung auf Senior-Level: Du hast mehrere Jahre Marketing-Erfahrung und einen Track Record, den man an Ergebnissen ablesen kann.

  • Du kennst das Umfeld: Du hast nachweisbare Erfahrungen im B2B- und SaaS-Umfeld. Ein besonderes Nice to have: Erfahrung in der Hospitality-Branche. 

  • Absolute Teamplayer-Mentalität: Wir planen, entscheiden und setzen gemeinsam um. Silo-Denken ist bei aleno komplett fehl am Platz. 

  • Du sprichst muttersprachlich Deutsch und sehr gut Englisch

title: Senior Game Designer
description:
We are looking for a passionate and experienced Senior Game Designer to work on Hunt: Showdown in our new state-of-the-art office in Frankfurt, Germany. In this role, you act as a bridge between all departments involved in the project and help bring complex, cutting-edge gameplay and meta features to life. You work closely with design, programming, QA, and other teams to ensure features are implemented smoothly and meet both creative and qualitative goals.

This is a hands-on role. You take ownership of features from concept through implementation and iteration. You are responsible for delivering high-quality gameplay and meta systems and supporting the team with your game design expertise.


What You'll Do
  • Take ownership of gameplay and meta features from early concept through to polished in-game implementation.
  • Design and support implementation of gameplay and meta systems using proprietary tools.
  • Create and maintain asset databases in CRYENGINE to support the team’s work.
  • Collaborate closely with design, programming, and QA to build features that meet both creative and technical goals.
  • Participate in regular playtests and use feedback to continuously improve your work.
  • Iterate on features to achieve a high level of quality, usability, and player experience.
  • Work together with other departments to ensure all required resources are aligned and delivered on time.
  • Observe and feedback on the game’s LIVE sentiment to stay on top of community hot topics, drive balancing decisions, and help prioritize pain points.
  • Share your game design knowledge and support others on the team when needed.
  • Contribute ideas to improve tools, systems, and workflows for everyone.
  • Partner with QA to identify, debug, and resolve issues in gameplay systems.

    • What You Bring
  • 5+ years of experience in Game Design within the game industry or a similar role.
  • Solid understanding of implementing and balancing gameplay and meta systems.
  • Strong Game Design skills in a LIVE/GaaS environment.
  • Passion for FPS-Games and Extraction Genre.
  • Experience with progression systems, economy design, and live service balancing.
  • Ability to communicate ideas clearly, both verbally and in documentation.
  • Motivation to learn, grow, and take on new challenges.
  • Willingness to relocate to Frankfurt, Germany.

  • Advanced knowledge of Office tools (e.g. Excel macros).

Our new workspace is designed to inspire creativity and collaboration, with open areas, quiet zones, and top-tier facilities — all just steps away from public transport, restaurants, bars and cultural hotspots.

About the Role

We're building WunderGraph Cosmo, the open-source GraphQL Federation solution. Probably the most important component of Cosmo is the Cosmo Router, which - simply put - connects all API endpoints and handles the GraphQL requests and responses whilst applying the Federation protocol (among other magical things, like normalization, execution planning etc.). Fully written in Go, it's the fastest GraphQL Router available and a quite potent (and complex) piece of cutting-edge open-source software. How about joining our team to make it even better and strap the rocket boosters onto GraphQL Federation?

 

TEAM INTEGRATION

You will be in charge of

  • Develop, refactor and maintain GraphQL Go Tools' (Router) open-source code base in Golang (low GC code)

  • Focus on performance, security and stability of the Router

  • Review Router telemetry to identify areas of improvement

  • Run internal penetration tests of the Router

  • Troubleshoot Router issues, potentially together with our customers' engineers

  • Analyze and accept up open-source contributions on Github

     

The "Engine" is essentially a Golang application which translates GraphQL requests into any other protocol, like OpenAPI, SOAP, gRPC, GraphQL, Apollo Federation, etc. You could consider the Engine as a "GraphQL Compiler" or Transpiler. The Engine is responsible for parsing, normalization, execution planning, execution runtime, etc... If you are interested in working with ASTs, AST transformations, etc... you will love this kind of work. We have performance requirements, so you should be proficient in writing performant and low GC code in Golang.

Some of your tasks will take more than a few weeks to complete, Ideally, you're someone who likes to go deep on one topic instead of going wide and shallow on many different topics.

  • Extend the Compiler "backend" to support Apollo Federation v2

  • Customers love our product because it works flawlessly, securely and fast - and because it looks darn pretty, too!

  • Pick your preferred work hardware

  • We focus on getting stuff done, and on having fun whilst doing so: work hard, play hard!

Our process also includes reference and background checks. We aim to respond or provide feedback in 2 or 3 days between each stage of the process. We're usually hiring through Deel as our Employer of Record, except for Germany or Florida where we're hiring directly.

 

WunderGraph is an equal opportunity workplace; we welcome people from all backgrounds. To keep up with us, follow us on LinkedIn or GitHub

You can find out more about our ways of working together here:

WunderGraph Public Handbook and Resources

We’re looking forward to your application so we can grow together!

Mit MyHunt / Jagdgefährte bauen wir die App, die Jäger:innen, Reviermanager:innen und Naturschützer:innen durch die gesamte Jagd begleitet – von der Planung über die Revierarbeit bis zur Dokumentation von Strecke, Wildbestand und Biodiversität. Hunderttausende Jäger:innen in Europa gehören zu unserer Community, und wir skalieren gerade international.

Damit sich unsere Nutzer:innen bei jedem Anliegen gut aufgehoben fühlen, suchen wir dich: als Werkstudent:in im Customer Support, 20 Stunden pro Woche, vor Ort in unserem Münchner Office.

Und damit das klar ist: Diese Rolle ist mehr als Tickets abarbeiten. Du bist die Stimme unserer Nutzer:innen im Team – was dir im Support auffällt, landet direkt bei Produkt und Entwicklung.

Aufgaben

Als Werkstudent:in im Customer Support bist du die erste Ansprechperson für unsere Community:

  • Du beantwortest Anfragen unserer Nutzer:innen per E-Mail, in den App-Stores und in unseren Community-Kanälen – freundlich, verständlich und auf Augenhöhe.
  • Du hilfst bei allem, was in der App hakt: von der Revierkarte über die Wildkamera-Anbindung bis zur Abo-Verwaltung.
  • Du reproduzierst gemeldete Fehler, dokumentierst sie sauber und gibst sie strukturiert an unsere Entwickler:innen weiter.
  • Du pflegst und erweiterst unsere Hilfe-Artikel und FAQs – damit häufige Fragen künftig gar nicht erst zum Ticket werden.
  • Du erkennst Muster: Welche Fragen kommen immer wieder? Wo verstehen Nutzer:innen ein Feature nicht? Dein Feedback fließt direkt in unsere Produktentwicklung ein.
  • Du unterstützt bei der Betreuung unserer Community und bei Nutzerbefragungen.

Qualifikation

Das erwarten wir von Dir

  • Du bist eingeschriebene:r Student:in (die Fachrichtung ist uns egal) und wohnst in oder um München – wir arbeiten gemeinsam im Office, weil Support im Team einfach besser funktioniert.
  • Du hast einen Bezug zur Jagd. Idealerweise hast du selbst den Jagdschein oder machst ihn gerade – denn wer weiß, wie ein Ansitz, eine Drückjagd oder die Streckenmeldung abläuft, versteht unsere Nutzer:innen sofort. Ehrliches, tiefes Interesse an Jagd und Naturschutz zählt aber genauso.
  • Du bist empathisch und geduldig. Auch wenn jemand frustriert schreibt, findest du den freundlichen, souveränen Ton – und die Lösung.
  • Du schreibst gut. Klar, korrekt und sympathisch, auf Deutsch (muttersprachliches Niveau) und Englisch (sicher in Wort und Schrift).
  • Du arbeitest eigenständig und verlässlich – wenn du eine Anfrage übernimmst, bleibst du dran, bis sie gelöst ist.
  • Du bist technikaffin genug, um dich in eine App einzuarbeiten und ein Problem präzise zu beschreiben. Programmieren musst du nicht können.
  • Ein Plus, aber kein Muss: weitere Sprachen (besonders Französisch, Spanisch, Italienisch), erste Erfahrung im Support oder Service, Erfahrung mit Tools wie Zendesk, Intercom oder Notion.

Benefits

  • Ein Produkt, das du selbst nutzt. Du arbeitest an einer App, die du am Wochenende im Revier dabeihast.
  • Echter Einfluss: Deine Beobachtungen aus dem Support verändern das Produkt – kurze Wege zu Produkt, Design und Entwicklung, flache Hierarchien.
  • Flexible Zeiteinteilung, die zu deinem Stundenplan passt, inklusive Rücksicht auf Prüfungsphasen.
  • Ein Office, in dem man gerne ist: geteilt mit anderen Ventures, Dachterrasse mit BBQ, Kicker- und Billardturniere, Freigetränke und so viel guten Kaffee aus der Siebträger, wie du willst.
  • Ein junges, internationales Team mit Leidenschaft für Technologie und nachhaltige Jagd.
  • Perspektive: Bei uns sind schon mehrere Werkstudent:innen nach dem Studium fest eingestiegen.

Kein Motivationsschreiben nötig. Schick uns einfach deinen Lebenslauf – gerne kurz – und beantworte uns zwei Fragen direkt im Bewerbungsformular:

  1. Ein:e Nutzer:in schreibt dir verärgert, dass die App seine bzw. ihre Streckenmeldung „verschluckt" hat und die Jagdsaison damit ruiniert sei. Wie antwortest du? (3–5 Sätze genügen.)
  2. Was ist dein Bezug zur Jagd? (1–2 Sätze.
    Wir melden uns innerhalb einer Woche bei dir.

Wenn es passt, laden wir dich zu einem lockeren Gespräch im Office, oder bei guten Wetter auch im Biergarten neben an ein ;)

title: Solution Architect
description:
About The Role

Taktile empowers financial institutions to transform into truly AI-native organizations. As we grow with enterprise customers across banks and insurance companies, their architecture questions get harder: How does Taktile fit into an existing, complex and some-times decades-old core banking system landscape? How do we design for their security, availability, compliance, and integration requirements? Who speaks the language of their enterprise architects?

That's this role. As Solution Architect, you are a senior technical voice in our customer conversations - a sparring partner to enterprise architects at large financial institutions, helping them design how Taktile fits into their broader solution architecture.

What You'll Do as Solution Architect

  • Act as the trusted architecture counterpart for enterprise architects and technical leadership on the customer side — from first pre-sales conversations through large-scale production deployments.

  • Design the target solution architecture for enterprise transformations: how Taktile integrates into the customer's existing landscape of core systems, data platforms, and surrounding services, and how that architecture evolves over a multi-year journey.

  • Own the hardest architecture questions in our deals — integration patterns, deployment models, throughput, latency, security, compliance, data residency — and turn them from blockers into reasons to buy.

  • Lead architecture workshops, whiteboarding sessions, and reference architecture reviews with customer stakeholders from engineers up to CTOs.

  • Represent Taktile in senior architecture discussions on the customer side, giving their enterprise architects and technical leadership a credible, expert counterpart.

  • Build reusable reference architectures, integration blueprints, and best practices that scale across the Forward Deployed Engineering and Sales teams.

  • Work across pre-sales and post-sales: supporting Account Executives and Solution Engineers on complex enterprise deals, and partnering with Forward Deployed Engineers to ensure what was sold is what gets built.

  • You bring 10+ years of experience in solution or enterprise architecture, with significant time spent working directly with large enterprises — ideally in financial services.

  • You hold your own with the most senior technical stakeholders on the customer side — enterprise architects, Heads of Engineering, CTOs — and are seen as a peer, not a vendor.

  • You hold relevant certifications (e.g., AWS Solutions Architect Professional, TOGAF).

  • You have experience responding to enterprise RFPs and security/architecture reviews.

title: Senior Video Producer
description:
About Platform Engineering

Platform Engineering (platformengineering.org) is home to the world's largest community of platform engineers. Through PlatformCon, one of the world's largest conferences dedicated to platform engineering, we bring together more than 50,000 engineers, technology leaders, and decision-makers every year to share ideas, showcase innovation, and shape the future of internal developer platforms.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Video Producer to own video across the organization, end to end.

This is a build-it role. We don't have a video function yet. What we have is freelancers, ambition, and an audience that already trusts us. You'll come in and create the system: how we shoot, how we edit, how we publish, and how our YouTube channel grows.

You'll own the craft and the pipeline. That means editing the bulk of our output yourself, but also deciding what camera our founders point at themselves, how their rooms are lit, how their audio is captured, and what "good" looks like before anyone hits record. It means owning our YouTube channel as a channel, with packaging, Shorts, retention, and growth all in scope, rather than treating it as a place to upload finished files.

We're a distributed team, so most of what we make is produced remotely. A few times a year we come together at offsites across Europe and beyond, and you'll turn those into concentrated production windows where we capture a quarter's worth of higher-production content in a few days.

  • Own end-to-end video production: concept, shoot setup, edit, post, publish, and performance review.

  • Coach on-camera talent, including our founders, on framing, audio, pacing, and delivery, and hold the standard once it's set.

  • Edit the majority of our weekly output across long-form, interview, explainer, event, and short-form content.

  • Own our YouTube channel: packaging, thumbnails, titles, descriptions, chapters, SEO, and publishing cadence.

  • Build and run our Shorts strategy as a deliberate format, not as offcuts from long-form.

  • Analyze channel performance across retention, CTR, watch time, and subscriber growth, and use it to decide what we make next.

  • Plan and run quarterly production sprints at our in-person offsites, including shot lists, scheduling, and directing local crew where needed.

  • Capture and repurpose content from PlatformCon and our other events.

  • Build the systems behind all of this: intake and brief formats, turnaround expectations, asset libraries, templates, and brand kit.

  • Manage a bench of external animators, editors, and specialists for advanced motion work and high-volume weeks.

What you'll bring

  • 5+ years of professional experience, including substantial hands-on responsibility for video production and post-production

  • Demonstrable ownership of video end to end. You've been the person responsible for the output, not one step in someone else's pipeline.

  • Expert-level editing skills in Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or Final Cut, with strong color and audio finishing.

  • Real command of production fundamentals: camera selection and settings, lens choice, lighting design, and audio capture, including how to get all of it right in a spare bedroom rather than a studio.

  • Genuine YouTube expertise. You understand how the algorithm actually rewards content, you've packaged videos that outperformed their baseline, and you can explain why a video underperformed beyond "the thumbnail was weak."

  • A track record with short-form: you know what makes a Short retain, and you've made them work as a format in their own right.

  • Systems thinking. You document what you build, and you'd rather fix a workflow once than fight it weekly.

  • Experience producing video for technical or developer audiences, and comfort with the subject matter.

  • Motion graphics and animation skills (After Effects or similar).

  • Experience growing a YouTube channel with numbers you can point to.

  • Podcast production and audio post experience.

  • Experience running multi-day batch shoots or studio days.

  • Familiarity with AI-assisted editing and production tooling, and a practical view on where it helps.

  • Experience working in a startup or scale-up, and with remote, globally distributed teams.

Why join us?

You'd be the first video hire at an organization that already has the audience, the access, and the credibility, and no one shaping how any of it looks on screen. There's no existing system to inherit or work around. You define it.

You'll have direct access to the people building and running the world's most interesting internal developer platforms, and the freedom to decide how their stories get told. If you want a role where your judgment sets the standard rather than executes someone else's, this is that role.

title: Geschäftsführer/-in & Unternehmensnachfolger/-in Unabhängige Vermögensverwaltung (UVV/EAM)
description:
Thrivo Wealth Partners AG

Geschäftsführer/-in & Unternehmensnachfolger/-in

Wealth Management · Thrivo Partner-Plattform · DACH

Senior Level · Operative Führung mit Equity-Pfad zur Mitinhaberschaft

Sie übernehmen die operative Führung eines etablierten unabhängigen Vermögensverwalters im DACH-Raum — und arbeiten von Tag eins mit einer modernen Plattform im Rücken: Wachstumskapital, Technologieinfrastruktur, M&A-Expertise und ein erfahrenes Peer-Netzwerk.

Der Übergang erfolgt schrittweise. Sie wachsen über Zeit in die alleinige operative Führung und in eine Equity-Beteiligung am Institut hinein.

Das ist eine der wenigen Rollen im Wealth Management, in der unternehmerischer Gestaltungsspielraum, etabliertes Mandantenbuch und moderne Plattform zusammenkommen.

Die Rolle

Sie übernehmen die Geschäftsführung eines Thrivo-Partnerunternehmens — eines etablierten unabhängigen Vermögensverwalters im DACH-Raum mit eigener Marke, eigenem Mandantenbuch und eigener Identität. Ihr operativer Arbeitgeber ist dieses Partnerunternehmen, nicht Thrivo selbst.

Der Übergang erfolgt schrittweise: Sie starten typischerweise als Co-Geschäftsführer oder Stellvertreter mit klarem Pfad zur alleinigen operativen Führung. Der Inhaber bleibt zwei bis fünf Jahre eingebunden, übergibt Mandantenbeziehungen strukturiert und steht beratend zur Seite. Parallel wachsen Sie schrittweise in die Equity-Beteiligung am Institut hinein.

Die Bestellung als Geschäftsführer einer regulierten Vermögensverwaltung ist genehmigungspflichtig (FINMA, BaFin oder FMA, je nach Standort). Thrivo koordiniert dieses Verfahren gemeinsam mit dem Partnerinstitut und Ihnen — von der Vorbereitung der Unterlagen bis zur Genehmigung.


Was Sie verantworten

  • Operative Führung des Partnerunternehmens: Mandantenbetreuung, Compliance, Risikomanagement, Reporting, Mitarbeiterführung

  • Übernahme und Pflege langjähriger Mandantenbeziehungen — vermögende Privatkunden, Unternehmer, Familien

  • Strategische Weiterentwicklung des Instituts gemeinsam mit dem Inhaber und Thrivo: Wachstum, Digitalisierung, Effizienz

  • Mitgestaltung der Roadmap für Bolt-on-Akquisitionen und organisches Wachstum

  • Aufbau und Führung des Teams im Institut

  • Vertretung des Instituts gegenüber Aufsichtsbehörden, Auditoren und Geschäftspartnern

Was Thrivo als Plattform mitbringt

Diese Rolle unterscheidet sich von einer klassischen GF-Rolle in einem unabhängigen Vermögensverwalter durch eines: Sie führen das Institut nicht alleine. Im Hintergrund steht eine Plattform, die Ihnen die Werkzeuge in die Hand gibt, die heute den Unterschied zwischen Stagnation und Wachstum ausmachen.

ThrivoOS — die Technologieinfrastruktur

Compliance-Automation, KI-gestützte Prozesse, modernes Reporting, digitale Mandantenkommunikation — eingebettet in das Institut, ohne Systemwechsel. Sie verbringen weniger Zeit mit operativer Last und mehr Zeit mit dem was zählt: Mandanten und Wachstum.

M&A-Unterstützung für Bolt-on-Akquisitionen

Wachstum durch Zukäufe ist für ein Institut alleine kaum stemmbar. Christopher Kraft und das Thrivo-Team identifizieren, strukturieren und begleiten Bolt-on-Akquisitionen für Sie — von der Erstansprache bis zum Closing. Sie konzentrieren sich auf die Integration, nicht auf die Transaktion.

Wachstumskapital

Thrivo stellt Kapital bereit für strategische Investitionen — neue Standorte, Teamerweiterungen, Technologieprojekte, Akquisitionen. Sie müssen Wachstum nicht aus dem Cashflow finanzieren.

Regulatorische Expertise & Bestellungsverfahren

FINMA-, BaFin- und FMA-Anforderungen werden komplexer. Thrivo unterstützt mit zentraler regulatorischer Expertise — bei laufenden Compliance-Themen, Auditprozessen und Inhaberkontrollverfahren ebenso wie bei Ihrer initialen Bestellung als Geschäftsführer. Die Koordination zwischen Inhaber, Aufsichtsbehörde und Ihnen läuft über uns.

Peer-Netzwerk

Sie sind nicht alleine. Sie werden Teil eines Kreises von Thrivo-Geschäftsführern, die vergleichbare Aufgaben in vergleichbaren Instituten verantworten — strukturierte Erfahrungsaustausche, gemeinsame Investitionsgrundlagen, geteilte Best Practices.

Equity-Beteiligung am Institut

Sie wachsen schrittweise in eine Eigenkapitalbeteiligung am Institut hinein. Die Struktur — Zeitpunkt, Bewertung, Konditionen — wird im Rahmen der Thrivo-Partnerschaft mit dem Inhaber vorverhandelt und ist Teil dessen, was wir beim Match strukturieren.

Das Unternehmen — Archetyp

Jedes Thrivo-Partnerunternehmen ist anders. Aber die Institute folgen einem wiederkehrenden Muster:

Profil

Etablierter unabhängiger Vermögensverwalter im DACH-Raum, in der Regel mit verwaltetem Vermögen zwischen CHF/EUR 150 Millionen und 1 Milliarde. Langjährig gewachsenes Mandantenbuch, klares Anlageprofil, stabile Margenstruktur. Häufig zwischen 5 und 20 Mitarbeitende. Inhaber typischerweise zwischen 55 und 70 Jahren.

Standort

Schweiz, Deutschland oder Österreich — abhängig vom konkreten Match. Standorte sind etabliert, mit eigenen Räumlichkeiten und gewachsener regionaler Verankerung.

Mandantenkreis

Vermögende Privatkunden, Unternehmer, Familien — Beziehungen die häufig über Jahrzehnte gewachsen sind. Diese Mandanten haben dem Inhaber persönlich vertraut. Sie bauen dieses Vertrauen schrittweise und mit Substanz weiter auf.

Wer wir suchen

Was Sie mitbringen

  • Mindestens 12 Jahre Erfahrung im Wealth Management — Private Banking, unabhängige Vermögensverwaltung, Family Office oder vergleichbare Umgebung — davon mindestens 3–5 Jahre in einer Leitungs- oder Geschäftsführungsfunktion

  • Persönliche Eignung für die Bestellung als Geschäftsführer einer regulierten Vermögensverwaltung — nachweisbare Leitungserfahrung, einwandfreie persönliche und berufliche Integrität, fachliche Qualifikation gemäss FINIG, WpIG oder vergleichbarem Rahmen

  • Praxiserprobtes Verständnis von Compliance, Risikomanagement und Mandantenschutz im regulierten Vermögensverwaltungskontext

  • Nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Führung von Mandantenbeziehungen auf Senior-Niveau, idealerweise mit eigenem AUM-Verantwortungsbereich

  • Bereitschaft und persönliche Reife, ein etabliertes Institut zu übernehmen — Respekt vor dem Aufgebauten, Geduld im Übergang, Mut zur Weiterentwicklung

  • Deutsch als Muttersprache oder verhandlungssicher; Englisch fliessend

Was uns zusätzlich interessiert

  • Eigene unternehmerische Erfahrung, sei es in einer Geschäftsführungsrolle oder als Mitgründer

  • Bestehendes persönliches Netzwerk in der DACH-Wealth-Management-Community

  • Erfahrung im Auf- oder Umbau von Beratungsteams

  • Affinität zu moderner Beratungsinfrastruktur und digitalen Prozessen

Wer Sie sind

Sie haben eine etablierte Karriere im Wealth Management. Sie verdienen gut, Sie sind nicht in Eile. Aber Sie spüren — vielleicht schon länger — dass der nächste Schritt nicht ein weiterer Wechsel zwischen Banken sein sollte. Sie wollen Verantwortung übernehmen, gestalten, mitbesitzen.

Sie verstehen, dass die operative Führung eines unabhängigen Vermögensverwalters etwas anderes ist als eine Direktorenrolle in einer Grossbank. Es ist näher am Mandanten, näher am Unternehmen, näher an der eigenen Verantwortung. Genau das suchen Sie — und Sie wissen, dass die Kombination aus etabliertem Institut und moderner Plattform genau der Hebel ist, der diese Rolle in den nächsten Jahren so wirkungsvoll macht.

Über Thrivo

Thrivo Wealth Partners AG ist eine Schweizer Holding-Gesellschaft mit Sitz in Zug. Unser Modell: Beteiligung an inhabergeführten Vermögensverwaltern, Orchestrierung der Nachfolge, geteilte Technologieinfrastruktur. Wir sind langfristiger Partner für zukunftsfähige Vermögensverwalter im DACH-Raum.

Das Team

Hinter Thrivo steht ein Team, das diesen Markt von verschiedenen Seiten kennt. Christopher Kraft hat als Investmentbanker bei Perella Weinberg Partners und in europäischen Wealth-Plattformen etliche Übergaben in der Vermögensverwaltung begleitet. Felix Lobkowicz hat fünf Unternehmen gegründet — eines bis zum Börsengang — und baut nun ThrivoOS, die Infrastrukturplattform die das Modell trägt. Finn Weise verantwortet Kapital und Governance: über eine Dekade Erfahrung im Aufbau von FinTechs und Finanzplattformen, zuvor bei Morgan Stanley und europäischen VC-Fonds. Im Verwaltungsrat sitzt Sebastian Henrichs, ehemaliger CEO der FNZ Bank Deutschland — der führenden Wealth-Plattform der Branche.

Hinter Thrivo

Hinter Thrivo steht ein Kreis von Investoren aus der Finanz- und FinTech-Welt — erfahrene Unternehmer, Operator und Family Offices, die diesen Markt verstehen und langfristig denken. Klassisches Private Equity haben wir bewusst ausgeschlossen. Eine Plattform, die Unternehmern Langfristigkeit verspricht, kann nicht selbst kurzfristig Rendite optimieren.

Wie es weitergeht

Wenn Sie sich angesprochen fühlen, lassen Sie uns ein vertrauliches Erstgespräch führen. Wir lernen einander kennen, hören Ihre Geschichte, verstehen Ihre Vorstellungen — und Sie verstehen, wie wir arbeiten.

Wenn das Gespräch zu einem Ergebnis führt, werden Sie Teil unseres Nachfolgekreises. Sobald eine konkrete Konstellation entsteht, die zu Ihrem Profil passt, kommen wir gezielt auf Sie zu — mit Details zum jeweiligen Institut, zur Region, zum Inhaber und zur Übergangsstruktur.

Aktive Suche, regelmässige Kontaktpflege und vollständige Vertraulichkeit sind selbstverständlich. Sie behalten jederzeit die volle Kontrolle darüber, ob und wie ein konkreter Kontakt zustande kommt.

Erstkontakt erfolgt direkt — eine kurze Nachricht mit Ihrem Hintergrund genügt. Wir antworten innerhalb von 48 Stunden persönlich.

ThrivoOS · Full-Time · Remote Europe · CET core hours

5–8+ years · Architecture ownership · Equity

About Thrivo

The independent wealth management industry is at an inflection point. AI, regulatory pressure, and a looming succession wave will determine which firms thrive — and which flounder — in the coming decade.

Thrivo Wealth Partners AG is a Swiss holding company based in Zug. Our model: partnering with founder-led independent wealth managers across the DACH region, helping them scale — organically and non-organically — and providing shared technology infrastructure. We are the long-term partner for future-ready wealth managers.

The Team

Christopher Kraft has accompanied numerous IWM transitions as an investment banker at Perella Weinberg Partners and in leading European wealth platforms. Felix Lobkowicz is a repeat founder — five companies, one IPO — and leads product and technology at Thrivo. Finn Weise leads capital and governance with over a decade of experience building fintechs and financial platforms, previously at Morgan Stanley and European VC funds. On the board: Sebastian Henrichs, former CEO of FNZ Bank Germany — the leading wealth platform in the industry.

Behind Thrivo

Thrivo is backed by a circle of investors from the finance and fintech world — experienced operators, entrepreneurs, and family offices who understand this market and think long-term. A platform that promises long-term thinking to founders cannot itself be optimising for short-term returns.

The wealth management market in Germany and Switzerland is digitising — more slowly than other sectors, but with real momentum now. Thrivo is building the technology infrastructure that underpins this transformation: a platform for founder-led wealth managers that deploys compliance automation, AI-assisted processes, and modern data architecture in a way that until now has only been available to large institutions.

ThrivoOS is not another fintech dashboard. It is the operating system for a growing group of partner firms collectively managing several billion AUM. You build this — as the first technical full-time hire and the engineering lead.

The Role

You own the technical leadership of ThrivoOS. You set the architecture, coordinate the freelance senior engineer, and are the engineering constant in a project that bridges complex regulatory requirements — MiFID II, WpHG, BaFin — with modern AI infrastructure.

You work directly with Felix Lobkowicz (CTO-in-function) on product vision and technical direction. The most important architectural decisions are yours. The architecture and stack have not been finalised — you will define them together with Felix and Tech advisors based on your experience and what is right for the platform.

This is one of the few roles in DACH fintech where technical depth, genuine entrepreneurial ownership, and real equity participation come together.

What you own

Architecture & Infrastructure

– Design and build an event-sourced backend architecture — the structural foundation for regulatory-grade auditability under MiFID II and BaFin requirements

– Multi-tenant data architecture: one platform, many partner firms, strict data isolation and RBAC

– Batch data ingest pipeline from partner firm systems (custodian banks, PMS) — the Phase 1 data foundation

– Cloud infrastructure on AWS (Frankfurt region) — we use hyperscaler-grade tooling from day one

Workflows & AI

– Advisory workflow engine — regulated advisory processes as structured, automated flows with compliance write-back (Jahresgespräch, KYC/AML as Phase 1 scope)

– AI integration: automated meeting briefings, Gesprächsprotokoll generation, and document assembly for advisors via Gemini/RAG pipeline

– Compliance infrastructure: PII anonymisation before any LLM call, encryption at rest, consent management — structural, not bolt-on

Team & culture

– Coordinate the freelance senior full-stack engineer: architectural decisions, code quality, mutual peer review

– Technical point of contact for the product advisor and design partner advisors during pilot deployment

– Set the engineering culture from day one — we use agentic coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code) as standard. We cover the cost.

What Thrivo offers

Real equity participation

Thrivo offers a VSOP participation in the Holding. Structure and terms in conversation.

Ownership from day one

As the founding engineer, you set architecture standards and engineering practices the team will carry for years. You are not executing tickets — you are building the platform.

First-class team

Direct collaboration with Felix Lobkowicz (5 consumer companies founded, one through IPO), Christopher Kraft (Perella Weinberg Partners, 50+ IWM transactions), Finn Weise (Morgan Stanley, VC) and Sebastian Henrichs (former CEO FNZ Bank Germany).

Compensation

We offer a competitive base salary and a meaningful VSOP participation in the Holding. Structure and exact terms in conversation.

What you bring

Requirements

– 5–8+ years of backend engineering in production systems — the right profile depends on depth of architecture experience, not years alone

– Event Sourcing and CQRS in practice — you have built it, not just read about it

– Domain-Driven Design — bounded contexts, aggregates, domain events

– PostgreSQL — schema design, query optimisation, pgvector

– AWS or comparable hyperscaler — production deployment, IAM, VPC, managed services

– Experience in regulated environments — fintech, banking, or insurance

– Senior enough to make architectural decisions independently and coordinate a freelance engineer

– CET timezone — daily overlap for peer review and fast alignment is required

What interests us additionally

– Go, TypeScript, or Java — we care about architecture patterns (Event Sourcing, CQRS, DDD), not the language on your CV. Experience with Go or willingness to work in Go is a plus.

title: Machine (Meta) Learner
description:
At kausable, we build causal, reasoning-first models that learn from a handful of examples and adapt without retraining. We are looking for a research scientist to advance the foundations of that approach, with a particular focus on Prior-Data Fitted Networks, meta-learning and the priors that determine what our models can learn. This is a research role with real implementation responsibility. You will form hypotheses, build the systems needed to test them and turn strong results into reproducible research, open-source work and production-relevant capabilities.

Tasks

Our research revolves around synthetic world data, deep-learning models trained and validated against it, and capable embedders across domains and modalities. You will:

  • Shape and pursue research questions around PFNs, meta-learning, in-context learning, representation learning, causality, active learning and adaptive decision-making.
  • Design priors and synthetic task distributions that expose models to useful structure, uncertainty and failure modes.
  • Develop model architectures and training methods for temporal, goal-conditioned and dynamical settings.
  • Build rigorous evaluations, including strong baselines, ablations, calibration tests and out-of-distribution diagnostics.
  • Implement research ideas reliably in Python and PyTorch, and improve the data and experiment pipelines around them.
  • Contribute to top-tier publications, open-source releases and the wider research agenda at kausable.

Requirements

We are looking for research scientists with a strong background in one or more of:

  • Deep expertise in PFNs, meta-learning, Bayesian inference, Neural Processes, representation learning, causality, active learning or a closely related area.
  • A record of generating original research hypotheses and testing them with scientific rigor.
  • Strong experimental judgment: you can distinguish optimization failure, prior misspecification and distribution shift.
  • Reliable implementation skills in Python and PyTorch or JAX.
  • A PhD in machine learning, physics, statistics or a related field, or equivalent research experience.
  • The ability to work independently, explain difficult ideas clearly and change your mind when the evidence demands it.
  • We are primarily hiring at senior level. We are also open to exceptional candidates with fewer years of experience who can demonstrate comparable depth, judgment and ownership.

Recommended qualifications:

  • A PhD in ML, Physics, or equivalent — or an MSc with exceptional experience
  • A strong grasp of causality, meta-learning, PFNs, and active inference
  • The ability to work independently and think from first principles
  • Hands-on experience with modern ML tooling (Python, PyTorch) and research workflows
  • An outcome-oriented mindset

Nice to have:

  • Causal modeling, active learning or Bayesian optimization.
  • Reinforcement learning, control, time-series modeling or dynamical systems.
  • Synthetic-data generation, graph-based models or simulation environments.
  • Publications at NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR or comparable venues.

Benefits

It depends on whats Prio. The kinds of things our EiRs take on:

  • People & Talent. Own a slice of how we find and assess the people who will define Atira. Source candidates for an open role, organize events, own branding and connect us into the ecosystem

We move fast and value adaptability. None of these specializations are set in stone and nobody knows where your passions and strengths cross better than you. We care more about your intrinsic motivation and the urge to solve problems than we care about your current year or major.

  • You build staircases. When the path forward isn't obvious, you figure out the first few concrete steps and start, instead of waiting for someone to make the plan

  • You've owned something real. A company or project you started, a leading role in a student initiative, a side build that shipped, or a job where you owned an outcome others would have delegated

  • You're intellectually honest. You say "I don't know" instead of bluffing, and you flag what's actually going on before someone has to ask

  • Full working proficiency in German and English

  • You can commit to at least three months full-time, on-site in Munich

Apply with your CV and two or three lines on a problem you owned and what came of it. No cover letter needed.

Three steps: a first call with one of us to get to know each other, a short case rooted in a real Atira problem, and a final conversation with a founder. We aim to go from application to decision in about two weeks.

As a UX / Front-End Engineer at Atira, you turn frontier AI from "demo-able" into "usable" inside the daily work of a sales engineer. You will design and build the surfaces where agents and humans meet and interact: Chat with human-in-the-loop, document review UIs that render complex multi-modal inputs (tables, drawings, configurator rules), agent timelines and trace views, diff and approval flows, internal tooling for our FDEs and AI engineers, and the design system that ties it together.

A misread requirement can cost a manufacturer six figures, so the UI that surfaces that requirement to a human reviewer is crucial. The challenges are real and the margin for error is thin.

Where you trained matters less than what you've built and the taste you bring. Atira is at a stage where you must own problems end to end, because what you ship today is what our customers use tomorrow.

What you will do

  • Own the surfaces where agents meet humans. Chat with HITL, agent step-by-step traces, approval flows, inline reviewing, editing of agent outputs and generative UI. The best agentic functionality is only as good as its usability & the underlying user trust

  • Lead our frontend architecture and design. You will own our frontend architecture and be responsible for our team shipping UI / UX in a scalable, consistent framing

  • Render complex, data-heavy documents. Industrials live in 1000-page RFQs, Excel pricing lists, BOMs, technical drawings, configurator outputs. You'll build the UIs that make these reviewable, diffable, and editable without dragging the browser to its knees

  • Build full-stack features end to end. From the React component to the route to the API contract, you ship vertical slices. You partner with FDEs and backend engineers but you do not wait on them

  • Set the bar for craft. Motion, interaction, latency, polish. You define the design system, component primitives, and patterns the rest of the team builds on. You care that a button feels right, not just that it works

  • Reliability and tests. Playwright coverage on the flows that matter. You think about loading states, error states, empty states, and what happens when the agent stream stalls at token 4,732

What we are looking for

Taste, depth, and taking problems personally, go deep until the interaction feels right, and own the outcome including the parts that broke.

Your profile

  • Very strong frontend fundamentals. Excellent TypeScript / React skills. You understand rendering behaviour, suspense, server components, concurrent features, and the gap between "code that works" and "code that won't haunt the next person." You can read someone else's production frontend, understand why it was built that way, and ship changes that make it more scalable

  • Strong taste. You understand and are opinionated around the right way of designing UI / UX to reduce user friction & unlock feature adoption

  • Experience with our stack or close alternatives: React, Next.js, the Tanstack ecosystem (Query, Table, Router and Start), Vite, Playwright. Tailwind, shadcn/ui, Radix etc.

  • You've gone further than most with AI-assisted development. Whether it's Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or your own setup, you've invested seriously in building the skills, context, and workflows to get maximum leverage from coding agents

  • You are a strong technical decision maker who knows how to make tradeoffs on rendering strategy, state management, data fetching, and component architecture, and can explain the pros and cons of every solution

  • You've demonstrated ownership and initiative: a company you started, a serious open-source contribution (UI library, design system, real commit history), a side project that grew to production scale, or a role where you owned a user-facing surface that others would have delegated. We want to see evidence that you build things without being told to

  • Degree in Computer Science, HCI, Design Engineering, or a related technical field from a strong technical university, or an equivalent record of shipped work

  • Full working proficiency in English. German is not required

What you'll get

  • Real ownership: you'll be one of the early team members and shape both product and architecture, while working closely with customers

  • Strong peers: work with people who have built and shipped AI systems in industrial environments at scale before, and the chance to learn directly from them

  • Impactful work: your code is deployed all across Europe's and the US's industrial backbone, affecting how complex products and services are sold and configured worldwide

  • Competitive salary & equity package and additional benefits including Wellpass, JobRad, and company dinners

  • Most importantly: collaborate and thrive in a high-performing but caring culture. We will own the industrial sales function but will do so with modesty and integrity

What success looks like after a few months

  • You've shipped the agent and human interaction surfaces that customers spend their day in, and FDEs cite them as a reason deals close faster

  • You own a core surface (chat, document review, agent trace, internal tooling, the design system) and the team trusts your judgment on how it should evolve

  • When something breaks on the frontend, you can trace issues across React, Next.js or Tanstack Start, the API contract, and the backing services, and fix them end to end

description:
Du liest Förderrichtlinien freiwillig bis zum Ende und kannst aus komplexen Förderbedingungen verständliche Orientierung für Unternehmen machen?

Bei uns übernimmst du keinen bestehenden Fachbereich, sondern baust das Themenfeld Förderung und Finanzierung für Unternehmensnachfolge selbst auf. Gemeinsam mit der Projektleitung entwickelst du die fachliche Ausrichtung und entscheidest, welche Förder- und Finanzierungsfragen wir aufgreifen und wie daraus verlässliche Informationsangebote entstehen. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit unserer Finanz- und M&A-Expertise zusammen und bringst dein Wissen selbst in Workshops und Veranstaltungen ein.

Worum es dabei geht: Jedes Jahr stehen Zehntausende kleine und mittlere Unternehmen in Deutschland vor der Nachfolgefrage. Bleibt sie ungelöst, verschwinden Betriebe, Arbeitsplätze, Wissen und regionale Wertschöpfung. Wir wollen dazu beitragen, dieses Rückgrat der deutschen Wirtschaft zu erhalten und Betriebe mit verständlichen Informationsangeboten und praxisnahen Veranstaltungen dabei unterstützen, Unternehmensnachfolgen erfolgreich vorzubereiten und umzusetzen.

Über uns: NDF ist die auf Fördermittel spezialisierte Marke der Key Progress Makers Advisory GmbH. Wir arbeiten vor allem mit Startups und innovativen Unternehmen, die neue Produkte, Technologien oder Geschäftsmodelle entwickeln und dafür passende Finanzierungsmöglichkeiten suchen. Wir helfen ihnen, Förderpotenziale zu erkennen und anspruchsvolle Vorhaben so zu strukturieren, dass aus einer Idee ein tragfähiges Projekt werden kann. Diese Erfahrung bringen wir nun in ein eigenes öffentlich gefördertes Projekt rund um das Thema Unternehmensnachfolge ein.

Aufgaben

  • Du entwickelst Workshops, Informationsangebote und digitale Orientierungshilfen zu Förderung und Finanzierung bei Unternehmensnachfolgen
  • Du vermittelst komplexe Förder- und Finanzierungsthemen verständlich in Workshops, Veranstaltungen und Fachformaten
  • Du recherchierst und analysierst Zuschüsse, Förderdarlehen, Bürgschaften, Garantien und weitere öffentliche Finanzierungsinstrumente für Unternehmensnachfolgen, Investitionen und betriebliche Transformationen
  • Du entwickelst Inhalte für die Projektwebsite, die digitale Plattform und weitere öffentlich zugängliche Informationsformate
  • Du arbeitest eng mit der Fachverantwortung für Finanzierung und M&A zusammen und zeigst, wie öffentliche und private Finanzierungsbausteine grundsätzlich zusammenspielen können

Qualifikation

  • Mindestens drei Jahre praktische Erfahrung mit Förderprogrammen oder öffentlichen Finanzierungsinstrumenten
  • Fundiertes betriebswirtschaftliches und finanzielles Verständnis
  • Erfahrung in der erfolgreichen Beantragung und Umsetzung öffentlicher Fördervorhaben für mittelständische Unternehmen, insbesondere in den Bereichen Innovation, Digitalisierung, Energieeffizienz und energetische Sanierung
  • Die Fähigkeit, Förderbedingungen eigenständig zu recherchieren, zu prüfen, einzuordnen und komplexe Finanzthemen verständlich und praxisnah zu vermitteln
  • Erfahrung in der Konzeption und Durchführung von Workshops, Informationsformaten oder fachlichen Veranstaltungen
  • Sehr gutes Deutsch und eine sichere professionelle Kommunikation
  • Eine strukturierte, gewissenhafte und eigenständige Arbeitsweise
  • Einen reflektierten Umgang mit digitalen Recherchewerkzeugen, Automatisierung und KI

Uns interessiert, mit welchen Förder- und Finanzierungsthemen du bereits gearbeitet hast, welche Verantwortung du dabei selbst übernommen hast und wie du zu belastbaren Ergebnissen gekommen bist. Entscheidend ist für uns außerdem, dass du mit Eigeninitiative und echtem Gestaltungswillen an neue Fragestellungen herangehst.

Passende Erfahrungen kannst du beispielsweise aus einer Förderbank, Bürgschaftsbank, Wirtschaftsförderung, Bank, Beratung oder dem Fördermittelmanagement mitbringen.   • Ein interdisziplinäres Team mit Expertise aus den Bereichen Unternehmensnachfolge, Startups und Finanzierung

  • Eine Arbeitskultur, in der wir Prioritäten realistisch setzen, Mehrarbeit ausgleichen und Schwierigkeiten früh ansprechen
  • Die Perspektive, auch nach der dreijährigen Projektlaufzeit gemeinsam weiterzuarbeiten und zusätzliche fachliche Verantwortung zu übernehmen

… du dir eine moderne, wertschätzende Zusammenarbeit wünschst und deine fachliche Arbeit gerne für ein Projekt einsetzt, dessen gesellschaftlicher und wirtschaftlicher Nutzen unmittelbar erkennbar ist.

title: Product Engineering Tech Lead
description:
TL;DR

We are hiring a Product Engineering Tech Lead to own the layer that runs our customers' AI applications: serverless, durable, streaming execution, and the observability that proves it works. You sit where backend engineering, platform operations, and product meet. This is a builder role with a founder mindset, not a maintainer role.

You’ll collaborate with top-tier tech talent, tackle meaningful challenges, and help transform complex AI into solutions that are simple, powerful, and ready for the real world.

What you will do

  • Own the serverless execution platform. Pipelines and agents need to run fast, reliably, and concurrently at enterprise scale, and they need to behave identically whether invoked serverless or running as a deployed service. You'll architect the execution layer that makes that true, including the durability work (surviving node evictions, spot terminations, rolling deploys) needed to keep long-running agents alive for hours, not seconds.

  • Own streaming and long-lived connections. Conversational and agentic workloads here are long-lived, not simple request/responses. You'll own how those connections behave under pressure: backpressure, graceful shutdown, reconnects, for both end users and API clients.

  • Lead the team and the architecture. Set technical direction, make the hard tradeoffs, and translate product strategy into a system that holds up under enterprise load. You stay hands-on on the problems that matter most, even as your day-to-day coding share shifts over time.

  • Make reliability provable. Own observability and metering: tracing, alerting, per-customer cost and usage visibility, so the platform's reliability isn't just a claim, it's something you can show a customer. You'll also own on-call and incident response, closing the loop between what you build and what you operate.

What you bring to the team

  • Builder and founder mindset. You have started things, shipped them, and lived with the consequences. You think about what is next, not only about fixing what is in front of you. Startup or founder experience is a strong signal here.

  • You have built and operated systems on Kubernetes in production, and you are comfortable working from the ground up. This role is not about owning one slice of an existing system, or only operating infrastructure someone else designed. It is product work: building something new and owning the outcome.

  • Durable execution experience. You have worked with durable, fault tolerant execution: retries, failover, durable state, and human in the loop. You understand the failure modes, not just the happy path.

  • Serverless and function platforms at scale. Knative, KEDA, OpenFaaS, Fission, or similar. You know scale to zero, warm pools, cold start tradeoffs, and per request isolation.

  • Streaming and long running workloads. Server sent events or websockets, long lived connections, and the operational reality of keeping them alive through deploys and node churn. Agentic or AI workloads are a plus.

  • Operator instinct. Observability, alerting, service levels, and incident response are second nature. You hold the platform to a production grade standard because it has to work reliably for real customers.

  • You can lead a team and connect strategy to robust architecture. You make the technical direction legible to the rest of the team and to the business.

  • Comfortable in Python and with infrastructure as code (for example Terraform) in a cloud native stack.

Nice to have

  • Built Kubernetes operators or controllers, or automated deployments as a system rather than a script.

  • Taken a platform from zero to one all the way to production grade ownership.

  • Open source contribution or maintenance background.

  • Exposure to B2B SaaS, LLM, or agent infrastructure.

  • Annual learning & development budget
